message:
Running command: cd /tmp && python3 -c "
# Construct H3 index: res 1, base cell 0, res1 digit = 7 (INVALID_DIGIT)
# bits: res1 digit at (15-1)*3=42..44, base cell 45..51, res 52..55, mode 59..62
h = 0
# mode = 1 at bits 59-62
h |= (1 << 59)
# resolution = 1 at bits 52-55
h |= (1 << 52)
# base cell = 0 (bits 45-51)
# res1 digit = 7 at bits 42-44
h |= (7 << 42)
print(hex(h))
print(format(h, '016x'))
"
